Hi Samira,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Healthway into production. To make the first session productive, can we lock a 60-minute kickoff next week focused on roles, access, and a short integration plan? Proposed windows (PST):

- Tue 11/16 10:00–11:00
- Wed 11/17 14:00–15:00
- Thu 11/18 09:00–10:00

Draft short agenda (attached: kickoff_agenda_v1.docx):
1) Introductions & objectives (5m)
2) High-level integration architecture + access matrix (15m)
3) Runbook & onboarding milestones (20m)
4) Next steps & owners (15m)

Please confirm which slot works and who from Healthway should attend (product, infra/IT, security, project manager). Also flag any pre-work we should prepare (SSO details, sample data access, contract item references).

I copied Marissa and Karthik from our onboarding team — Marissa will lead the session, Karthik will cover infra access.
